newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Krasnoyarsk Elektrosvyaz listed on RTS. [CORRECTED 18:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Russian Krasnoyarsk Elektrosvyaz listed on RTS. [CORRECTED 18:10 GMT]

text.p: Russian telecoms company Krasnoyarsk Elektrosvyaz shares on Wednesday were added to the Russian Trading System, national brokers' association NAUFOR's listings committee said on Thursday.

Both preferred and ordinary shares of Krasnoyarsk Elektrosvyaz, in Siberian Krasnoyarsk, are now listed on the RTS index. There are 10,028,736 ordinaries and 3,342,912 preferred, both in 50,000-rouble denominations.
(Corrects company sector, location of Krasnoyarsk and clarifies that company was listed on the Russian Trading System but not included in its index).
